About VR Insulation

30+ years of getting insulation right, joint by joint.

VR Insulation is a Pune-based industrial insulation contractor working across India — from refineries and power plants to food processing lines and pharmaceutical facilities. We handle hot insulation, cold insulation, dual (combination) systems, weatherproof cladding, thermal audits and full insulation consultancy, for both new-build and revamp projects.

Why Choose Us

Trained, safety-briefed site manpower on every project

Dedicated supervisors for piping work and equipment/vessel work

Quality checked against drawing and specification — not just the finished look

Transparent execution timelines and material traceability

What We Do

Built to hold the line, hot or cold.

Six core services, applied to piping, vessels, tanks and ductwork on sites across the country.

Hot Insulation

Insulation for high-temperature piping, vessels and equipment, specified per process temperature and finish.

Rockwool / LRBCalcium SilicateCast-in-Situ

Cold Insulation

Vapour-sealed systems for chilled and cryogenic lines that stop condensation and heat ingress.

PUF / PIRFoam GlassAerogel Mats

Dual (Combination) Systems

For lines carrying both hot and cold services. Hot insulation is always applied first, then cold, with thickness matched to the system's higher temperature.

Combination BuildsCyclic Service

Weatherproof Cladding & Sheeting

Aluminium, stainless steel and GI cladding over insulation, sealed against monsoon and coastal weathering. Bends, elbows and reducers are prefabricated to exact size.

AluminiumStainless SteelGI / Aluzinc

Thermal Insulation Audits

On-site energy-loss surveys that flag degraded or missing insulation and quantify the savings from fixing it.

Energy AuditsLoss Surveys

Insulation Consultancy

Specification and planning support for new-build and revamp projects, from material selection to execution sequencing.

New ProjectsRevamps
